items.title: What Does Netflix (NFLX) Gain From Bill Ackman’s Return?
items.summary: Bill Ackman’s Pershing Square has reentered Netflix (NasdaqGS:NFLX) with a significant position after previously exiting the stock. The hedge fund’s move reflects renewed confidence in Netflix’s competitive position in streaming. Ackman has said Netflix has effectively won the streaming wars and has pointed to an expectation of double digit revenue growth.
